||A GPU is a specialized processor designed to perform many calculations in parallel, especially for graphics, video, machine learning, and other data-intensive tasks. Memory bandwidth matters because a GPU can only process data as fast as it can receive it from memory; if bandwidth is too low, the GPU may sit idle waiting for data, limiting overall performance even when it has plenty of computing power.
